definitions.confirmed: Resolved file exists and every available declared SHA256/dimension matches. Does not confirm art acceptance, actual image model, or complete delivery.
definitions.uncertain: Missing, unresolved, conflicting reference occurrences plus inferred canonical candidates tracked separately. No claim that uncertain means missing artwork.
definitions.uniqueFileCount: Distinct resolved files actually inspected, including direct current provenance bases, masks and metadata; not native production count.
definitions.archiveMemberCount: Declared package entries checked within existing ZIP without extraction; separate from filesystem reference counts.
